entries.text: I planted a linden seed in the clearing as the sun went down.
Night 1: the new root grew 14 m and drank water 3.4, nitrogen 2.7, phosphorus 1.0, potassium 1.4.
The seed sprouted at dawn.
A misty morning; dew hung on every blade of grass.
The linden is 0.7 m tall with 3 leaf clusters.
Night 2: the new root grew 13 m and drank water 1.3, nitrogen 1.1, phosphorus 0.7, potassium 0.8.
The old roots drew water 2.1, nitrogen 1.5, phosphorus 0.3, potassium 0.5 from the soil overnight.
Dew sparkled on the meadow in the first sun.
The linden is 1.4 m tall with 13 leaf clusters.
Night 3: the new root grew 34 m and drank water 2.8, nitrogen 3.2, phosphorus 1.2, potassium 1.6.
Night 3: the root found what feeds the nettles in the north, the one I wished for.
The old roots drew water 1.4, nitrogen 0.0, phosphorus 0.0, potassium 0.0 from the soil overnight.
The linden is 2.2 m tall with 21 leaf clusters.
Night 4: the new root grew 41 m and drank water 4.4, nitrogen 3.7, phosphorus 1.4, potassium 0.3.
The old roots drew water 0.5, nitrogen 0.0, phosphorus 0.0, potassium 1.5 from the soil overnight.
Dew sparkled on the meadow in the first sun.
The linden is 3.3 m tall with 36 leaf clusters.
A light shower passed over the clearing in the afternoon.
Night 5: the new root grew 41 m and drank water 2.9, nitrogen 4.4, phosphorus 1.6, potassium 0.7.
The old roots drew water 2.9, nitrogen 0.0, phosphorus 0.0, potassium 1.5 from the soil overnight.
Wood anemones are flowering in the shade of my crown, where the meadow grass has thinned.
Mist lay over the clearing this morning.
The linden is 4.1 m tall with 41 leaf clusters.
Night 6: the new root grew 41 m and drank water 1.6, nitrogen 5.0, phosphorus 0.7, potassium 2.5.
The old roots drew water 5.2, nitrogen 0.0, phosphorus 1.2, potassium 0.0 from the soil overnight.
Mushrooms came up in the shade after the damp.
The linden is 5.4 m tall with 51 leaf clusters.
Night 7: the new root grew 46 m and drank water 4.0, nitrogen 5.8, phosphorus 2.2, potassium 0.5.
The old roots drew water 3.8, nitrogen 0.0, phosphorus 0.0, potassium 2.4 from the soil overnight.
1 shaded twig died back in the crown.
The linden is 6.1 m tall with 59 leaf clusters.

diary.wish: Today, find what feeds the clover in the west.
